title: Order-Bank Bonus for Fleet Units Ordered Ahead of Delivery
content:
**Fleet program bulletin, Vehicle Purchase Agreements, Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement**

A unit ordered ahead of delivery earns an order-bank bonus. The bonus is set by the calendar days from the unit's contract date to its delivery date.

## Schedule

- **More than 30 days** from contract date to delivery date: USD 300.00.
- **From 15 to 30 days**, both ends included: USD 150.00.
- **Fewer than 15 days**: no order-bank bonus.

## Boundary table

| Calendar days from contract date to delivery date | Order-bank bonus |
|---|---|
| 14 | none |
| 15 | 150.00 |
| 30 | 150.00 |
| 31 | 300.00 |

The count is plain calendar days between the two dates. Delivery on the contract date itself counts as 0 days.

**Hypothetical example.** A unit contracted on 3 February and delivered on 9 March of the same non-leap year is 34 days from contract to delivery. It earns 300.00.
